I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands on **Nov 3, 2025**.

That date comes from Moss's Coastal digest of Sunday, Nov 2, 2025, which says the account "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." The digest doesn't name Kwame as the new owner, and I found no CRM record or other source that does. I told him to confirm that against the CRM before he enters it. I also reminded him that "PHL" is shared with Covey & Lark Retail (now Pellow Home Living), which is a separate account.
